falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 index closes above 5,200 (10% above current level) within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear breakout would invalidate the HOLD signal by demonstrating strong upward momentum contrary to the current unknown verdict

falsification_conditions.condition: US Non-Farm Payrolls report shows employment change of +250k or more (vs. forecasted 180k) within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant positive surprise in labor market data would contradict the HOLD by indicating strong economic growth that would typically drive markets higher

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score increases to 80+ within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score exceeding 80 would indicate extreme overbought conditions, directly contradicting the current HOLD by suggesting an imminent reversal

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
